articles.title: Brewers 'still have tremendous faith' in struggling Kyle Harrison
articles.description: Left-hander Kyle Harrison's struggles continued in a 7-4 loss to the Pirates on Sept. 17. But he and the Brewers remain hopeful of a turnaround.

articles.title: Brewers 5, Pirates 1: Milwaukee clinches NL Central title
articles.description: The Brewers hope to clinch their fourth straight Central Division title against the Pirates at PNC Park on Tuesday night, Sept. 15.

articles.title: Brewers to host rally, watch party Sept. 22, offer playoff tickets
articles.description: The Brewers will host a 'Rally for October,' where fans can get early access to playoff tickets and much more during a stadium watch party Sept. 22.

articles.title: Brewers’ Brice Turang puts bowling hobby on hold: Cost ‘is insane’ | Lori Nickel
articles.description: Brewers infielder Brice Turang, who has cracked two bowling balls but never 300, has put his hobby on hold. Besides, he said, the games are so pricey.

articles.title: Kyle Harrison will start series finale for Brewers against Pirates
articles.description: Kyle Harrison, who's scuffled badly of late and was removed from the rotation, will get another chance to start against the Pirates on Sept. 17.

articles.title: De La Cruz HR leaves stadium on anniversary of Fielder's Milwaukee HR
